script_text: Leo, your fierce Fire nature is about to collide with a sharp Saturnian checkpoint this week. Through Wednesday, Mars squares Saturn in your seventh house, testing partnership boundaries and draining collaborative momentum. Monday becomes nearly impossible for binding contracts, while Tuesday swiftly clears the path via Mercury sextiling Uranus. A definitive turning point arrives Wednesday night when Venus shifts into Taurus, activating your tenth house of ambition. Late week energy stabilizes quickly. From Thursday onward, your ruling Sun trines Jupiter across your financial axis, unlocking a lucrative weekend offer. Romantic friction finally transforms into devoted security. Tuesday reigns as your ultimate power day because Mercury harmonizes with Uranus in your communication sector. Monday remains your most treacherous day as the Moon squares natal Saturn, clouding financial judgment. Channel your solar pride into structured delegation rather than exhausting solo execution. Follow my channel for daily astrological updates.
